streams.name: aiot_tilt_stream
streams.sql: CREATE STREAM aiot_tilt_stream (dev_eui STRING, device_id STRING, table STRING, data STRUCT(angle_x FLOAT, angle_y FLOAT, reporting_angle_threshold FLOAT), received_at BIGINT) WITH (DATASOURCE="aiot/sensors/+/t34955", TYPE="mqtt", FORMAT="json", SHARED="true")

streams.name: aiot_tilt_temp_stream
streams.sql: CREATE STREAM aiot_tilt_temp_stream (dev_eui STRING, device_id STRING, table STRING, data STRUCT(temperature FLOAT, angle_x FLOAT, angle_y FLOAT, event_code BIGINT), received_at BIGINT) WITH (DATASOURCE="aiot/sensors/+/t34957", TYPE="mqtt", FORMAT="json", SHARED="true")

streams.name: aiot_imu_stream
streams.sql: CREATE STREAM aiot_imu_stream (dev_eui STRING, device_id STRING, table STRING, data STRUCT(acc_x FLOAT, acc_y FLOAT, acc_z FLOAT, gyro_x FLOAT, gyro_y FLOAT, gyro_z FLOAT, event_code BIGINT), received_at BIGINT) WITH (DATASOURCE="aiot/sensors/+/t34958", TYPE="mqtt", FORMAT="json", SHARED="true")

rules.description: 기울기 센서 임계값 초과 경보 (t34955 경사계, 10도 이상)
rules.sql: SELECT dev_eui, device_id, table, data->angle_x AS angle_x, data->angle_y AS angle_y, received_at, 'tilt_alert' AS type, 'sensor' AS source FROM aiot_tilt_stream WHERE ABS(data->angle_x) >= {{TILT_THRESHOLD}} OR ABS(data->angle_y) >= {{TILT_THRESHOLD}}

rules.description: 기울기+온도 센서 기울기 임계값 초과 경보 (t34957, 10도 이상)
rules.sql: SELECT dev_eui, device_id, table, data->temperature AS temperature, data->angle_x AS angle_x, data->angle_y AS angle_y, data->event_code AS event_code, received_at, 'tilt_alert' AS type, 'sensor' AS source FROM aiot_tilt_temp_stream WHERE ABS(data->angle_x) >= {{TILT_THRESHOLD}} OR ABS(data->angle_y) >= {{TILT_THRESHOLD}}

rules.description: 온도 임계값 초과 경보 (60도 이상 위험)
rules.sql: SELECT dev_eui, device_id, table, data->temperature AS temperature, data->angle_x AS angle_x, data->angle_y AS angle_y, received_at, 'temperature_alert' AS type, 'sensor' AS source FROM aiot_tilt_temp_stream WHERE data->temperature >= {{TEMP_HIGH_THRESHOLD}}

rules.description: t34957 event_code 발생 시 진동/충격 경보
rules.sql: SELECT dev_eui, device_id, table, data->temperature AS temperature, data->angle_x AS angle_x, data->angle_y AS angle_y, data->event_code AS event_code, received_at, 'vibration_alert' AS type, 'sensor' AS source FROM aiot_tilt_temp_stream WHERE data->event_code = 1

rules.description: t34958 IMU event_code 발생 시 진동/충격 경보
rules.sql: SELECT dev_eui, device_id, table, data->acc_x AS acc_x, data->acc_y AS acc_y, data->acc_z AS acc_z, data->event_code AS event_code, received_at, 'vibration_alert' AS type, 'sensor' AS source FROM aiot_imu_stream WHERE data->event_code = 1
